preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct strings that can be obtained after performing exactly one swap.
